# Official supplier product photographs

The Floer and Rivièra Maison photographs are downloaded unchanged from their official public product pages for this comparison catalogue. Each catalogue entry links to its source. These photographs are displayed as product previews, not used as seamless floor texture scans.

Provenance, source URLs, retrieval dates, image hashes and collection coverage are recorded in `dist/catalog-floer.json` and `dist/catalog-riviera.json` in the project. The 3D materials are separate digital approximations of colour/pattern/format.
